integrity: The proof is symbolic and cutoff-free. The bundled exact-arithmetic program supplies bounded regression checks only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(n\ge2\) with \(\Omega(n)\le2\), fixed coprime integers \(a>b\ge1\), and \(k\ne0\). It does not classify solutions with \(\Omega(n)\ge3\) or improve global sporadic-solution exponents.
title: Exact \(\Omega(n)\le2\) classification and phase transition for \(b\sigma(n)=an+k\)
